subject: Media Literacy
title: Media Bias Charts and Their Limits
description: A short lesson to help you apply Media Bias Charts and Their Limits.

hook.text: An infographic ranks every news outlet on a left-right spectrum. It goes viral. But who rated them, and how?

buildup.text: Media bias charts attempt to map outlets on a political spectrum, from far left to far right.

discovery.text: Charts like Ad Fontes Media and AllSides use different methodologies — panel reviews, content analysis, or reader surveys.

twist.text: These charts simplify complex realities. An outlet can lean left on social issues and right on economics.

climax.text: Bias charts are starting points, not verdicts. They help but shouldn't replace your own critical analysis.

punchline.text: A chart can point you in the right direction. It can't think for you.

quiz.question: What is a key limitation of media bias charts?
options: They oversimplify — an outlet can lean different directions on different issues
